title: "Brand/Generic Table"
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

#print("HI!")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## Load CSV
## Note: If you encounter issues with characters, try resaving the
## CSV as a UTF-8 CSV. Excel... does not like interpreting as UTF-8
## Find the bad UTF-8 lines
# library("xfun")
# read_utf8("brand-generic.csv")
data <- read_csv("brand-generic.csv", comment = "#")

## Need to keep 1st column when doing buttons so the CSV renders properly
datatable(data,
    rownames=FALSE,
    escape = FALSE,
## Search builder is helpful with 3+ columns
#    extensions = c('Responsive', 'Buttons', 'SearchBuilder'), 
   extensions = c('Responsive', 'Buttons'), 
    options = list(
    dom = 'QBfrtip',
    pageLength = 20,
    class = 'stripe',
##    buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print')),
    buttons = list(
      'copy', 'csv', 'excel',
      list(extend = 'pdf', 
           orientation = 'landscape',
           exportoptions=list(pageSize='LEGAL'#,
#           customize = JS("function(doc){doc.styles.tableHeader.color='purple';}")
                )),
      'print')
))

```
